community.title: Community rules
community.description: How to get along on SagaShelf: what we expect from everyone and what is not allowed.
community.intro: SagaShelf is a place to share what you like. These rules keep it friendly for everyone. They complement the <terms>Terms of use</terms>.

respect.title: Treat other people well
respect.discriminate: discrimination based on origin, gender, orientation, religion, disability or any other condition;
respect.impersonate: pretending to be someone else, or choosing a username that impersonates them.

content.title: Mind what you publish
content.intro: On your profile and in anything you share, do not post:
content.piracy: links to pirated or illegal content;
content.private: other people's personal data without their permission.

spoilers.title: Spoilers
spoilers.body: If you mention a major twist of a story, warn first so everyone can decide whether to read it.

age.title: Minimum age
age.body: You must be at least 13 to create an account. If you think a minor created one, write to us and we will delete it.

report.title: Reports and consequences
report.body: If you see something that breaks these rules, write to {{email}}. We may remove content and suspend or delete accounts that do not follow them.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Where SagaShelf's data comes from and who gets the credit.
credits.intro: SagaShelf does not own the data of the titles it shows. Here is where it comes from and who we thank.

tmdb.title: TMDB
tmdb.notice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
tmdb.noticeCourtesy: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
tmdb.body: Movie, series and anime data comes from TMDB. SagaShelf does not store its images.

soon.title: Sources to be added
soon.intro: SagaShelf does not use these sources yet. When it does, they will be shown with this credit:
soon.tvmaze: Episode schedules from <site>TVmaze</site>, licensed CC BY-SA.
soon.wikidata: Relations between titles from <site>Wikidata</site> (Powered by Wikidata), public domain (CC0).
soon.googleBooks: Books from <site>Google Books</site>, for display only and never stored.

openLibrary.title: Open Library
openLibrary.body: Book data (titles, authors, years and descriptions) and covers come from <site>Open Library</site>, a project of the Internet Archive. Covers are shown through SagaShelf and are not stored.

mangadex.title: MangaDex
mangadex.body: Manga data (titles, authors, status and synopses) and covers come from <site>MangaDex</site>. Only metadata is used: SagaShelf shows no chapters, has no ads and no paid features. Covers are shown through SagaShelf and are not stored.

nonCommercial.title: A non-profit project
nonCommercial.body: SagaShelf is a personal, non-profit project: it shows no ads and charges for nothing. TMDB and MangaDex do not allow commercial use without a license, so each source's terms will be reviewed before any paid feature is added.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We only use necessary cookies, so there is no notice to accept. <site>More in the Privacy policy</site>.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What data SagaShelf stores, what it is used for and what your rights are.
privacy.intro: SagaShelf is a personal, non-commercial project to search and track anime, movies, series, books and manga. This policy explains what data we store and what you can do with it.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: SagaShelf is run by its creator as a personal project. For any question about your data, write to {{email}}.

data.title: What data we store
data.intro: We store only what is needed for your account to work:
data.account: Account: your email, your username and, if you use a password, a protected version of it. Clerk manages the password and SagaShelf never stores it.
data.google: Google sign-in: if you choose it, Google shares your email, name and profile photo with Clerk. We do not access anything else in your Google account.
data.profile: Profile: your display name, bio, language, privacy level and the photo you choose.
data.technical: Technical data: when you visit the site, the hosting provider records request data (such as the IP address, the requested page and the browser) to run and protect the service.
data.analytics: Usage statistics: we measure how many visits each page gets and how fast it loads with Cloudflare Web Analytics. According to Cloudflare, it uses no cookies or browser storage and does not identify each person: it mostly receives load timings and page views.

not.title: What we do not do
not.body: We do not sell your data, we do not show ads, and we do not use tracking cookies.

processors.title: Who it is shared with
processors.intro: We use these providers to run the service:
processors.neon: Neon: hosts the database where your profile is stored.
processors.cloudflare: Cloudflare: hosts the site, delivers the pages, protects it from abuse and measures visits and speed with Web Analytics.
processors.outro: These providers may process data outside Mexico, including in the United States. We use them only to run the service.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use only necessary cookies: one that remembers your language, one that remembers whether you prefer light or dark mode, one that remembers how you like to see your library (covers, titles only or grid), and Clerk's session cookies, which keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data while your account exists. If you delete your account, we erase your profile, username, email and everything you created (library, lists and follows), and Clerk deletes your sign-in data. Only an internal record with no personal data stays, so the account cannot be reactivated by mistake. Server logs are kept for a limited time, and the database provider may keep backup copies for a short period.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: In your settings you can download a copy of your data, change your profile and delete your account. For any other request (access, correction or objection to the use of your data, the ARCO rights and their equivalents in other laws) write to {{email}}.

age.title: Minors
age.body: SagaShelf is not aimed at children under 13. If you think a minor created an account, write to us and we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If what we store or who we share it with changes, we will update this page and its date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using SagaShelf you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: The service
service.body: SagaShelf is a personal, non-commercial project. It is offered as is, with no guarantee that it is always available, and it may change or stop working at any time.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for the activity of your account and for keeping your access safe. You must be at least 13 years old, give us true information and have only one account.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.harass: harass, threaten or discriminate against other people;
use.spam: send spam or post misleading content;
use.piracy: share links to pirated or illegal content;
use.abuse: try to get into accounts or systems without permission, or overload the service;
use.impersonate: pretend to be someone else, or choose a username that impersonates them.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You are responsible for what you write in your profile (name, bio and photo). You choose who sees it with your privacy level. You keep your rights over your content and allow us to show it in the service according to that choice.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.body: We may suspend or delete accounts that break these terms or put the service at risk.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent the law allows, SagaShelf and its creator are not responsible for losses that result from using the service or from it being unavailable.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. When we do, we will change the date of this page.
